items.title: Benny Powell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 16, 1999 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Anyway, these are the members of Count Basie’s band. These are alumni. Because I think in this picture there’s Joe Newman, Frank Wess, me with hair

ctx.x: How we doing there, Tim? The pictures.

Oh yeah, as I was digging out, I don’t know I was going through looking for other things and I happened to find, I’ve got a whole archive in my house man, because I’m one of those people who saved everything. I’ve got newspaper clippings from Count Basie when I was with his band in the 50s in Europe. In fact I’ve got some pay receipts from Lionel Hampton from 1948, just because I kept all these things. Anyway, these are the members of Count Basie’s band. These are alumni. Because I think in this picture there’s…

band leader friend. This was taken on a tour with Randy Weston, when Dizzy Gillespie was sick. We were in Europe at the time. This is Randy of course, this is Talib Kibwe, this is Stafford James and me, and Eric Assasnte, that’s his name, Eric Ajie is the comic. Eric Assante. When Dizzy was sick we took this picture, we love you Dizzy, to send to him. Again, this is taken at the same party and the same people. I don’t know who this gentleman is at the top here. Do you recognize him?

items.title: Frank Wess interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: We used to listen, Benny Powell and I used to listen to tapes from that band

ctx.x: That ain’t no competition, we were out of the park, we weren’t even in it. We used to listen, Benny Powell and I used to listen to tapes from that band, boy we’d listen to those tapes and laugh, ‘cause the band was so sad it was funny, you know. And Duke was fired up. But we had a lot of spirit, but that was all. The band was just sad that’s all. That was funny. Another time I was really embarrassed. I was working with this dance hall band and I was, I guess 16 or 17 years old, something like that. And this band…
Glen Gray, he was a pretty popular group at the time. Right?

items.title: Frank Wess — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You said you were celebrating your birthday, having a birthday drink with Benny Powell.

ctx.x: You seemed to be having some fun when I called the other day .You said you were celebrating your birthday, having a birthday drink with Benny Powell.
Oh yeah, well like I say, the fellas come in and we play for three or four hours, we play everyday. So that day when you called…
